name: Doraemon
description: Doraemon is an anime TV series created by Fujiko F. Fujio and based on the manga series of the same name. This anime is the much more successful successor of the 1973 anime.

videos.title: Dream Town, Nobita Land
videos.overview: The episode starts with Nobita getting bored. Then Suneo invites them to play Dodgeball, but when they get to the place they usually play gets turned into a place to put materials. Then Doraemon takes out a camera which can make miniature versions of buildings. They successfully make Nobita Land and invited their friends to play, but it gets destroyed by Nobita's Mother in the end. The episode ends with all the scrap metal landing on Doraemon.

videos.title: Transformation Biscuits
videos.overview: The episode starts with Nobita's mother asking Nobita to buy desserts to treat their visitor. He goes up stairs and finds a box of Transformation Biscuts. He eats a cat shaped one and then takes the box to the visitor, who eats four of the biscuits. Then his mother reminds him to buy the desserts. He then goes to buy desserts and to his shock, turns into a cat for five minutes. Later, Nobita and Doraemon then try to stop his mother from seeing the transformation happening on the visitor. The episode ends with Nobita's father fainting upon seeing that Nobita's mother had turned into a rabbit after eating a biscuit.

videos.title: Memory Bread for Testing
videos.overview: The episode starts with Nobita running into Doraemon and asking him for a tool to help him study for his examinations that takes place tomorrow. Doraemon gives him some Memory Bread which Nobita eats and understands the work. Later, he relaxed and ate desserts until he became full, but Doraemon forces him to eats extra memory bread. The episode ends with Nobita vomiting and re-eating memory bread from the start the very next day.

videos.title: N & S Emblems
videos.overview: The episode starts with Gian playing with two magnets. Nobita then says that he should know about magnetic properties in kindergarten. Gian then gets really angry and chases after Nobita. Nobita runs home and asks Doraemon for help, and he gives Nobita some N and S emblems after successfully testing them on Nobita's parents. Then he puts a S emblem on Nobita and the other S emblem on Gian. Nobita then escapes from Gian, but he instead makes a mistake and ends up being attracted to Gian. The episode ends with Doraemon ignoring Nobita when he pleads for help.

videos.title: Wrestling Killer
videos.overview: The episode starts with Nobita and Gian being almost late for school and running into each other. An angry Gian then knocks Nobita down, causing him to be late. Doraemon tries to aid Nobita with a Wrestling Killer tool. At first, Nobita mistakes it for a gun, but later understand how it works and uses it to knock Gian down. Later Suneo tricks him and he sets the tool to knock Suneo down, but accidentally caused it to turn against him. He then wastes ¥100 trying to stop the tool. The episode ends with Nobita falling down the stairs.

videos.title: Nobita's Bride
videos.overview: The episode starts with Nobita and Doraemon celebrating Nobita's birthday. Then they go to the future and they try to find Nobita's bride, who turns out to be Shizuka. Then they almost get beaten up by Nobita's son in the future due to a mix-up, for Nobita's son looked just like him. The two escaped with injury and find Shizuka in Nobita's house presenting him with a present. The episode ends with Shizuka and Nobita walking away.

videos.title: Doraemon's Prediction
videos.overview: The episode starts with Nobita getting home and wanting to go to Shizuka's house to play, but is stopped by Doraemon. He then open a book and tells Nobita that if he goes out, he will get in hospital because he will be hit by a truck. After persuasion by Shizuka, Doraemon goes outside with Nobita and uses a "future mirror" to see what will happen to them in 10 seconds time. Eventually, after near-accidents, they make it there but when he opens the door he gets hit by a toy truck on the head. The episode ends with Nobita laughing with Doraemon. First use of flying hats.

videos.title: Dinosaur Hunting
videos.overview: Doraemon and Nobita's first time travel. They get into a drawer which leads to them travelling on a time machine and end up ten billion years in the past. After shrinking one dinosaur, Doraemon cannot find his gun but they manage to escape the second one, with Nobita leaving his glasses behind, which are found in the present time, to the amazement of scientists.

videos.title: Spy War About Top Secret
videos.overview: The episode starts with Nobita breaking his teacher's vase while he was cleaning the classroom with Suneo. Suneo agreed to help Nobita cover up his crime, on the condition that he must do whatever Suneo wants. Fearing his teacher, Nobita reluctantly agreed. Along the way, Suneo and his friends taunt Nobita about the vase. Doraemon furiously takes out a tool that spies on Suneo's house, and Nobita found out that Suneo had a habit of bedwetting. Suneo's plan backfired when Nobita taunted him with his secret bedwetting habit. In the end, Suneo's friends wanted to taunt Nobita by making him do a headstand and bark like a dog, but Suneo, fearing that Nobita may uncover his secret, did the headstand.

videos.title: Lucky Gun
videos.overview: Nobita has some bad luck so Doraemon gives him a gun which shoots red bullets (actually bursts of light) for good luck and black bullets for bad luck, but no way of deciding which you get. Cowardly Nobita has 3 others try it first and they all get good luck. A little boy takes the gun and shoots Nobita with a black bullet and he gets all bad luck.

videos.title: Build Up Subway
videos.overview: Nobita and Doraemon use a digging machine to build their own subway as a birthday present for Nobita's father so he doesn't have to take the very crowded public subway to work.

videos.title: One Time Exam at Least in the Life
videos.overview: Doraemon lends Nobita a computer pencil which writes all the answers to his homework. Gian steals it and uses it in an exam to get 100% but his mother thinks he is cheating and beats him.

videos.title: Game of Exchanging Mom
videos.overview: Nobita, Shizuka and Suneo are all fed up with their mothers so Doraemon arranges it for them to swap parents and they find that moms are not so bad after all.

videos.title: Air Combat
videos.overview: Doraemon gives the gang model planes which shrink them down so they can fly inside them. Gian gets the only jet plane and shoots the others down, then afterward rests on top of the Tokyo Tower, only to have his model plane fall off, stranding him there.

videos.title: Door Out of Nothing
videos.overview: Nobita wants his independence from his family so Doraemon gives him a door which when placed against a wall, creates a room behind it which can be lived in. Nobita finds he is not ready to leave home yet.

videos.title: Run, Machine-Horse!
videos.overview: Cry baby Nobita has boasted that he will enter a stilt race tomorrow but he does not know how to walk on stilts so Doraemon goes to the 22nd Century to get him a cross between a stilt and a horse. Gian steals it so Doraemon becomes a tough teacher as he trains Nobita to walk on stilts. The mechanical stilt horse runs amok in Gian's house.

videos.title: Yes, I Do
videos.overview: A new girl nearby ignores Nobita. Doraemon gives him a cupid's bow whose arrows will cause anyone he shoots to love him. The first arrow hits a dog, then an ugly girl. An ugly man accidentally shoots Doraemon. Finally an arrow hits the girl and she falls for Nobita but he ends up being chased by the ugly girl who still has a love arrow in her.

videos.title: Traffic Tools Combination
videos.overview: Nobita wants to fight monsters using Doraemon's toys which give him the power of a plane, a tank and a submarine but finds he gets only petty jobs.

videos.title: Pretty Mai
videos.overview: Doraemon falls madly in love with a toy cat. The owner lets him have it after he rescues it from a dog and he uses 22nd century technology to make it as real as he is, only to find out that it too is a male cat.

videos.title: Toy Troop
videos.overview: Gian wants to beat up Nobita so as Doraemon is busy with a puzzle, he sends out five toy soldiers who attack anyone who is even slightly angry with Nobita, including his mother.

videos.title: The Fish Flag Float
videos.overview: A poor boy (Tzo) has no father so cannot afford fish flags so Doraemon uses a cloud machine and has some fish flags produce young who quickly grow up into fish flags for Tzo.

videos.title: Old Tool Competition
videos.overview: Nobita is jealous of Suneo's collection of antiques so he tries Doraemon's time cell phone to swap modern things with old things held in a 22nd Century antiques shop. Nobita misuses it and ends up getting stark naked in front of Shizuka and his other friends.Nobita quickly flees and on the way home,gets caught by a cop for naked-walking.Just when it seemed that the worst was possibly behind him,the stark naked Nobita gets witnessed by a few gorgeous girls,who just couldn't believe their eyes but tried to make Nobita feel as vulnerable as possible by even laughing at the unforeseen sight. Nobita finally manages to get hold of the cell phone and orders a few 22nd-century clothes for himself. Unfortunately, however, it was too little too late as he had already been caught stark naked in front of quite a big party.

videos.title: Making Craft is Fun
videos.overview: Doraemon gives Nobita a giant paper cut-out book which makes things that really work like a flying saucer, and a dinosaur which wants to eat them.

videos.title: Glove Breaking in Beast of Prey
videos.overview: Gian wants to beat up Nobita so Doraemon gives him a glove which makes Gian behave like a friendly dog.

videos.title: Ancestors, Come On
videos.overview: Suneo boasts about his Samorai ancestor so Doraemon and Nobita go back in time to see Nobita's hunter ancestor, and get caught up in a small war. Doraemon gets an arrow through his head but just pulls it out.

videos.title: Girl Like a White Lily
videos.overview: Weird! The beautiful young girl who gave Nobita's father chocolate when he was hungry as a boy turns out to be Nobita.

videos.title: Say One Thing but Mean Others
videos.overview: Doreamon produces a magic flute which when used makes people do the opposite of what they intended. Nobita uses it on a thief.

videos.title: Time Camera
videos.overview: Mr. Nobi, Nobita's father has lost his wallet so using a camera which can photograph past events, Nobita and Doraemon track it down.

videos.title: Proposal War
videos.overview: The episode begins with Nobita's mother preparing a fine meal in celebration of the twelfth anniversary of Nobita's father and hers wedding. At dinner, Nobita's mother and father have conflicting memories on who proposed first. They fight, and Doraemon takes Nobita back in time to find out just what happened. On the day of the proposal, they see Nobita's future father running late. To teach him a lesson, Nobita's future mother pretends to walk off, but decides to go back to him once it appears he has suffered long enough...

videos.title: Machine Arranging Things
videos.overview: Doraemon helps Nobita and his father see a new film using a machine which can reserve anything so no one else can use that thing first. Nobita inadvertently traps 3 of his friends at home all afternoon and Gian promises revenge.

videos.title: Tanuki Machine Changing the Body
videos.overview: After Suneo upsets Nobita by saying he looks like a cartoon raccoon, Doraemon gives Nobita glasses which makes Suneo see the illusions that he wants him to see, and so upset Shizuka and Gian.

videos.title: Why Do You Care about Whose Stuff is Whose
videos.overview: Shizuka agrees to study with Nobita but when Gian asks her, she goes with him instead. Cry baby Nobita moans to Doraemon who gives him a pad where anything he writes in it comes true.

videos.title: Kissing Ass Lipstick
videos.overview: Nobita's too honest comments upsets his parents so Doraemon gives him a lipstick which makes him charm everybody. His mother finds a discarded lipstick which makes wearers insult everybody and Nobita comes home to find her and his father shouting insults at each other.

videos.title: Missing Grandmom (Part 1)
videos.overview: Looking through some old photos, Nobita is very upset as he misses his (dead) grandmother who made a lot of fuss over him. Against his will Doraemon takes them back 8 years. Nobita upsets his mother who doesn't recognize him as her 3 year old son.

videos.title: Missing Grandmom (Part 2)
videos.overview: Nobita gets to meet his grandmother and finds he was a bit of a bratty kid. Again upsetting his then mother and self, his grandmother protects him again and he shows her what he looks like in his school uniform before leaving.

videos.title: The Beeper to Go to the Future
videos.overview: Despite being told not to, Nobita plays with Doraemon's machine, finding it calls a UFO from far away. The alien is upset, being called for no good reason but they manage to placate it with beer. Nobita's mother upsets it and it wants to invade the Earth but is again placated by Nobita's marble collection.

videos.title: My Teacher
videos.overview: Nobita's parents decide to get him a tutor as his grades are bad so Nobita decides to use himself 3 years in the future to answer his school questions now. But his future self is dumb because Nobita did not study and that Nobita too has a future self who turns up and complains that he is dumb too because Nobita 3 years in the future did not study either.

videos.title: Nobita in the Mirror
videos.overview: Nobita wants lots of toys but can't afford them. Using Doraemon's magic mirror, what he holds up to it is copied, so he borrows toys and copies them. But Nobita also gets copied himself producing a mischievous Nobita.

videos.title: Dimensional Copy
videos.overview: Nobita cannot go out so Doraemon produces some magic paper that makes paper copies of anything including Nobita (also see ep 24). However as soon as they leave, a wind blows away the paper figure of Nobita which then has a number of adventures.

videos.title: Take Submarine into the Sea
videos.overview: Doraemon produces a miniature submarine which makes many jumps into all sorts of liquids including a toilet bowl on its way to the sea.

videos.title: Friendship Capsule
videos.overview: Suneo tries to lure Doraemon from Nobita but he won't go so he gives Suneo a capsule which makes anyone your friend as a consolation. Cunning Suneo uses it to make Doraemon become his friend.

videos.title: Gaku Cross
videos.overview: Nobita is too lazy to do his homework without pressure so Doraemon gives him a headband which is painful if anyone says "close", which Doraemon uses to make Nobita do what he should do.

videos.title: Apartment Tree
videos.overview: Nobita wants his own apartment so Doraemon gives him a tree which grows rooms underground and the gang move in.

videos.title: Use Time Machines to Get the Inmates
videos.overview: Nobita is wrongly blamed for breaking a school window. A time machine helps him find out what really happened.

videos.title: Shooting Championship
videos.overview: Doraemon gives Nobita an ointment which when rubbed on your fingers, you shout "peng" and a jet of air powerful enough to knock someone over comes from your finger, so allowing the gang to play at shooting each other.

videos.title: Finebox
videos.overview: Gian busts another football so all the gang say they have no money for another one. Doraemon produces a small robot which takes 100 yen from anyone who does something bad, to get money for a new ball. Bully Gian quickly falls foul of it.

videos.title: Nobita's Adventure
videos.overview: Nobita wants to live on an island like Robinson Crusoe, but is such a helpless cry baby that hidden Doraemon has to keep helping him.

videos.title: Air Diamonds Manufacturing Machine
videos.overview: Doraemon gives Nobita a machine which produces blocks of solid air which stay in position. Unfortunately he forgets to tell Nobita that they vanish after a time, leaving him hanging high up in the air.

videos.title: Continuing Atomizer
videos.overview: Spray it on a picture and you see what would happen next in the picture, like a ship moving. Nobita ruins a man's art collection trying it out.

videos.title: Take Back the Lost Machine
videos.overview: Doraemon produces a machine which can find anything that has been lost, even Nobita's long lost baby bottle, which reminds him of his kind grandmother.

videos.title: The Pre-requisite Antenna
videos.overview: Like a TV antenna, it allows the wearer to be prepared for any event that will happen very shortly.

videos.title: Sound Nugget
videos.overview: Gian is giving Nobita trouble so Doraemon gives him a medicine which makes his words into solid letters which can be used as weapons.

videos.title: Star of Hope
videos.overview: Doraemon decides to get rid of some useless inventions, including the Star of Hope. Gian and Suneo dig it up, not realizing that the wishes it grants are always wrong.

videos.title: Become Thunder
videos.overview: Doraemon produces a small thunder cloud to cure Nobita of his fear of thunder. This done, Nobita uses it to shock people.

videos.title: XYZ Light Camera
videos.overview: A special camera can see through things including clothing. Not knowing this, Shizuka wants Nobita to take a picture of her. Some nudity.

videos.title: House Robot
videos.overview: Nobita tries to get the better of bully Gian using Doraemon's things from the future, but Gian has things from the future too and gets the better of him.

videos.title: The Love of Machines
videos.overview: Nobita is doing poorly with girls so Doraemon makes him a girl to love him but the powerful machine gets jealous of Shizuka and angry when Nobita's mother shouts at him.

videos.title: Take Out the Cloud to Play
videos.overview: Nobita is working on his tan when a cloud covers the sun. Doraemon gives him a machine which controls clouds and he uses it to scare Shizuka and a friend as well as Gian. Then it overheats.

videos.title: The Sellotape of Fact
videos.overview: Suneo butters up everybody, to Nobita's annoyance so Doraemon gives him a square of sellotape which when put on Suneo's back reveals his true bad personality to everyone.

videos.title: Fake Universe Man
videos.overview: Gian and Suneo trick Nobita with a fake UFO so Doraemon comes up with a real one and a remote controlled alien, then make the pair regret their joke.

videos.title: My Birthday
videos.overview: Nobita is a bad boy and has let his parents down. He becomes convinced he is adopted so he and Doraemon go back ten years in the past to find out the truth. The name "Nobita" means hero.

videos.title: Go to School by Bow and Arrow
videos.overview: A special arrow is fired from a bow and if you hold onto the string tied to it, it will take you to wherever the target is, even across the city. Gian and Suneo are angry and move Nobita's target.

videos.title: With Mirror Ads
videos.overview: Anything held in front of a telescope mirror appears on every shiny surface in the area so Nobita thinks it can make a fortune if used in advertising. Unfortunately, the images sent startle people.

videos.title: The Snail Room is Very Relaxing
videos.overview: Nobita has lost a test paper and his mother thinks he is lying. Very upset at this, he retreats into a giant snail shell Doraemon gave him and nothing can touch him in there.

videos.title: Man-Making Machine
videos.overview: Doraemon tells Nobita not to touch a machine he has, so Nobita tries it out and it makes a very powerful demon child with strange powers.

videos.title: Steal Mom's Diamond
videos.overview: Nobita's mom tells him a story of 2 men who stole her mother's valuable diamond when she was a child (so they don't have it now to sell for lots of money). Nobita and Doraemon go back into the past to stop the theft.

videos.title: Hot Powder
videos.overview: Nobita cannot swim so Doraemon uses a powder on him which makes him able to swim through the ground or anything else solid as though it were water, so he can learn to swim. Bit of nudity.

videos.title: Shopping in the Future
videos.overview: Nobita wants a new bike but his parents cannot afford it, then he comes across a catalog from 2087 and orders and gets many things, not realising that they have to be paid for.

videos.title: The Robot-Control-Training Machine
videos.overview: Nobita wants to be a space pilot so Doraemon brings out a machine where a remote controlled small saucer gives an impression of being on an alien world, even when in Shizuka's bath room when she is taking a bath. Nudity.

videos.title: Tatami
videos.overview: Nobita and Doraemon both like rice cakes but fight over the last one so Doraemon uses a DIY paddy field to grow lots of rice and a machine to make lots of rice cakes but with 259 of them to eat, the two still fight over the odd one.

videos.title: Cat Runs a Company
videos.overview: Nobita takes four cats off of Shizuka's hands as a favor but his mother doesn't want them in the house. Doraemon uses bracelets to control them and the cats become obedient mousers in the neighborhood.

videos.title: Speed Clock
videos.overview: Nobita can't wait for a holiday from school so Doraemon gives him a clock which can make the days fly by. Nobita ends up making his vacation fly by as he tries to please everyone.

videos.title: Girlfriend List
videos.overview: A machine which can predict future girlfriends causes trouble for Nobita when he visits them before they will know him. He realizes he is best off with Shizuka.

videos.title: Pocket Telescope
videos.overview: Gian steals Nobita's yoyo so Doraemon gives him a telescope where when you look at something, you can reach there and pick up something from the scene. Or if an immovable object like a tree, you can travel to the scene.

videos.title: Home's Further and Further Away
videos.overview: Nobita eats a biscuit used to get rid of dogs. Once they leave home they can't find their way back. Nobita tries not to leave home but does and gets lost.

videos.title: Bribe War Plan
videos.overview: Gian will only have the best people on his baseball team and Nobita is the worst. A bribe stick given to someone makes them do what you want, and Nobita takes Suneo's place on the team.

videos.title: We Can't Read in the Sahara
videos.overview: Nobita wants a different environment to study in so Doraemon uses a machine which can make the surrounding area look like any place in the world. In the desert scene they see a man dying of thirst.

videos.title: Cram Mirror
videos.overview: A true vanity mirror that makes everyone look good and tells them how good they are, but it has a malicious streak and convinces Nobita he is handsome when he pulls an ugly face.

videos.title: Peck Rope
videos.overview: A rope that can bring anything falls into Suneo's hands and he uses it to take stuff from the other kids, then Nobita gets the blame but a good deed reveals the true villain.

videos.title: Go Forward the Devil Road
videos.overview: Nobita is inspired by a book of Great Men and resolves to do good deeds but they all turn out bad. He gets angry and resolves to do bad things, which all turn out good.

videos.title: The Medicine of Boy Students and Girl Students
videos.overview: Nobita's father moans at him because he doesn't like boy's games. Doraemon uses a spray which makes boys behave like girls and girls behave like boys. Nobita doesn't like the result and even less when he finds it has affected his parents too.

videos.title: The Pengpeng Leaf
videos.overview: A dog is very cruelly mistreated by a violent owner. The Pengpeng leaf, placed on the dog's head causes it to swap places with its owner, so the dog has a day of freedom as the human being while the owner is chained up as the dog.

videos.title: The Forgotten Iron Hammer
videos.overview: A man goes around the houses in the neighborhood trying to find out who he is. Doraemon hits him over the head with the forgotten hammer which causes his memories to be projected on a wall.

videos.title: Happy Life
videos.overview: Nobita is so bored he annoys Doraemon into giving him a smiling earphone. When Nobita puts it in his ear, he hears lots of funny stuff which makes him laugh uncontrollably. This first upsets his mother, then his friends who thinks he is laughing at them.

videos.title: Space Mountain Tai, The Forepart
videos.overview: Space Mountain Tai about prehistoric men and spacemen is Nobita's favorite show but he meets the star and finds it has gone over budget too much and is close to being canceled because of falling viewing figures. He decides to help him by going 150 million years into the past to get some real dinosaurs to replace the poor models they use in the show.

videos.title: Space Mountain Tai, The Postpart
videos.overview: After a few narrow escapes, Doraemon and Nobita feed mealie pellets (which make any animal tame) to a load of dinosaurs. Doraemon fixes his time machine to a hut door so when Tai and his producers walk through the door, they are 150 million years ago. The show becomes a success thanks to the "real looking dinosaurs and scenery" which cost nothing.

videos.title: The Soul Machine
videos.overview: Cry baby Nobita is upset when he grazes his knee and his mother doesn't make a fuss of him. He wishes he was a baby again, so Doraemon sends his soul back to his baby body and his mother fusses a lot over him. Nobita comes back to the present to find his mother very upset as she thought he had died and realizes she does really still care about him.

videos.title: Even It's in the Gaster-Water
videos.overview: Shizuka accidentally swallows her mother's opal which is worth 500,000 yen. Doraemon and Nobita use the miniature sub from episode 41 to recover it from inside her, but play a trick on her which results in Nobita swallowing an eraser, which will have to be recovered.

videos.title: Channel of Dream
videos.overview: Nobita can't sleep so Doraemon gives him a TV that lets him see people's dreams. He finds that he is represented as cowardly and a cry baby in all his friend's dreams, and even in his own dreams.

videos.title: Development and Degradation Radiation
videos.overview: Nobita's father is old fashioned, so Nobita uses Doraemon's ray gun to make things as they would have been in the past or future, then starts on living things with a mouse de-evolutionized 200,000,000 years to become a large dinosaur and his father evolved into a future man.

videos.title: The Super Armor
videos.overview: The Emperor's New Clothes, as in non-existent armor which does not work for stupid people. It fools Nobita then Gian who also tries it on.

videos.title: Hot Spring Travel
videos.overview: Nobita's mother wants to go to the hot springs for a holiday but his father says it is too crowded and hard to get there, so Doraemon sets up 3D projectors around the house which make it look like they are at the hot springs.

videos.title: If Gian's a Superman
videos.overview: Gian grabs a "superman" cloak off of Nobita who has grabbed it from Doraemon, and puts it on. It gives him the power to fly when someone blows a flute, but it is cursed in that he must help one hundred people before he is able to take it off again and even if the bath will still have to go if a flute is blown.

videos.title: Mouse and Bomb
videos.overview: Doraemon is even more scared of mice than Nobita's mother is and starts shooting at everything that moves when one turns up in the house.

videos.title: Fantastic Pellet
videos.overview: Despite having learned to swim in episode 68, Nobita can't swim so Doraemon gives him a pill that allows wishes to come true, so Nobita can learn to swim by swimming through the air.

videos.title: Special Vision Report
videos.overview: Nobita cannot remember what he has done with the money he and Doraemon has saved. Instead of using the hammer from episode 84, Doraemon uses a machine which projects memories on a wall.

videos.title: Human Remote Control
videos.overview: Gian is in charge of baseball practice but is a tyrant so Nobita uses a remote control box on Gian which controls him like a robot.

videos.title: Disgust Maker
videos.overview: After Gian tricks Nobita into running away from a worm, something he cannot stand, Doraemon uses a machine to first make Gian scared of puppies, then scared of Nobita.

videos.title: Huko the Typhoon
videos.overview: Nobita hatches a 22nd-century egg and out comes a small typhoon, which he treats as a pet. Then Japan suffers a major typhoon which is heading towards their house which has a loose roof and the little typhoon goes out to try and stop it.

videos.title: Unexisting Shower
videos.overview: To avoid getting hit by Gian, Nobita uses a shower which makes it look like he is several feet away from his actual position, which allows him to kick Gian without retaliation.

videos.title: Predicting Bug
videos.overview: Nobita who was born on August 7 checks his astrology in a comic and thinks he is due a good week. Doraemon gives him a small mechanical bug which if you predict something, it can come true. The problem is that Nobita is a pessimist who thinks the worst, and it was last week's comic he was using.

videos.title: Wonder Rope
videos.overview: Gian, Suneo and Shizuka are riding bikes but Nobita does not join them because he cannot rise a bike. Doraemon gives him a wonder rope (one of many he has), a harness which enables a cat or dog to be like riding a horse. Nobita falls off a cat, then a dog and as he saddles the second dog, along comes Gian and Suneo riding a cat and a dog. Shizuka gets on the dog Nobita just saddled and they ride off, leaving him alone again.

videos.title: Slowly Panicking
videos.overview: Nobita is slow so Doraemon produces fast and slow pills, so he can speed up. Nobita does not want to try them so Doraemon has a few speed pills and rushes everywhere fast, then ready to slow back to normal, he takes what he thinks are slow pills but are more speed pills and rushes everywhere like a speed demon. Then Nobita accidentally takes slow pills and becomes even slower and his parents try some fast pills, thinking they are sweets.

videos.title: Detecting Badges
videos.overview: Nobita can't find his friends, so Doraemon gives him shiny badges for them which on a screen will always show where they are. But their mothers learn of this, so can find their kids to scold or punish them. The kids decide to find Nobita to scold and punish him.

videos.title: Forgetful Bird
videos.overview: Nobita's father has become very forgetful so Doraemon gives him a model bird which perches on his shoulder and reminds him when he forgets anything. But he ends up coming home without the bird which he has forgotten.

videos.title: Vending Machine
videos.overview: Doraemon has a vending machine which is also a time machine. Example: You can use it to buy things at prices in 1925 so very cheap and Nobita makes money selling cut price things to his friends. He decides to try some sweets from the future (2561 AD) and they are heavenly, but so is the price of 230,000 yen which Nobita cannot pay.

videos.title: Grandpa in the Dream
videos.overview: Nobita's father dreams that his father tells him to be strict with Nobita so he gives Nobita a hard time. Nobita and Doraemon travel back to the past and find Grandpa is very strict but secretly has a heart of gold. They explain to him and he goes 30 years to the future to tell dad to be kind to Nobita.

videos.title: Paper Machine Man
videos.overview: The other kids beat Nobita at paper sumo, where paper figures fight each other, so Doraemon produces special paper from which Nobita makes a paper sumo a few inches high but stronger than a real sumo.

videos.title: Black Belt Nobita
videos.overview: Gian is being taught judo by his father and teaches it to Nobita, by beating him up. Doraemon produces a black belt which when worn makes anyone a judo expert, but anyone who touches Nobita gets thrown including Shizuka and their teacher.

videos.title: Ultra Mixer
videos.overview: Shizuka’s dog and cat fight so the mixer makes them into a dog-cat. Nobita uses it at home on a pot and their bath to produce an ornate bath, but then everything goes downhill from there, especially when he uses it on himself and Doraemon and one part of him wants to go out to play while the other part wants to sleep.

videos.title: The Making of Desert Island
videos.overview: Rent has gone up so Nobita’s parents have to make economies. Doraemon and Nobita hit on making an underwater volcano erupt to produce lava which will make them their own offshore island where they will not have to pay rent. It works but everyone wants a piece of the island, then the government take it over.

videos.title: Typhoon Maker
videos.overview: Gian bullies Nobita into tidying up his room so in revenge Doraemon uses a typhoon maker and Nobita controls it so it goes to Gian's house and room and leaves it looking like a typhoon hit it, which makes his mother start beating him up.

videos.title: A World Does Not Use Money
videos.overview: Nobita moans because his mother won't give him any money. Doraemon produces a telephone booth which you can use wishes for so Nobita wishes for a world without money. What he gets is a world full of money that no one wants. Get a model kit worth 26,000 yen and the shop keeper gives you the money as well as the kit. Pick pockets put money in people's pockets and beggars try to give away money. Nobita for once has a fortune that he does not want.

videos.title: Reversal arrow
videos.overview: A strange arrow makes everything work opposite so a fridge produces heat like an oven, a razor makes a beard grow and a light produces darkness. It even makes stupid Nobita smart.

videos.title: Secret Treasure of Nobita Choweiman
videos.overview: Nobita's father finds an old family treasure map but they cannot find the treasure so Nobita and Doraemon go back 130 years to his ancestor to see exactly where it was buried.

videos.title: Plan Clock
videos.overview: Doraemon is upset that Nobita wastes so much time so produces a clock which will make Nobita work to a schedule. Nobita writes out a schedule but unfortunately Doraemon puts it in the clock so is forced to do all the things regardless of circumstance, like watching a TV that is broken and playing baseball in heavy rain.

videos.title: Ancient Venture
videos.overview: Nobita does not understand that where they live now was once underwater, so they go back ten billion years and find it is so but get stranded there. Some nudity.

videos.title: Everywhere Cannon
videos.overview: Doraemon produces a cannon which in use with a TV will send anyone anywhere. Nobita is going to try it out with his friends but a bank robber wants to use it.

videos.title: Flying Fish
videos.overview: Nobita is jealous of Suneo's carp pond so Doraemon gives him some magic food which when fish eat it, they can swim through air like it is water and they are tame. Suneo is jealous of Nobita's flying fish so steals the food and gets his sea captain uncle to use it on fish out at sea. A box arrives for Suneo and when opened is full of deep sea flying fish monsters.

videos.title: Moving Everywhere
videos.overview: Nobita is jealous of a boy who has moved many times as he has always lived in the same place. Doraemon uses a model flying house which when it finds an ideal place, can move their house there. After two bad choices, Nobita moves the house out into the country where he and Doraemon play in the forest for a while, then back to the city. However, his mother has left the house and is now marooned miles from anywhere.

videos.title: Dream Walker
videos.overview: A machine which fits on the head allows someone to live a dream. After a bad tryout, Nobita settles on adventure but then comes up against all sorts of monsters before finding treasure. Doraemon is his dog in the dream.

videos.title: Ghost Lamp
videos.overview: The kids meet to tell ghost stories but Nobita is hopeless so Doraemon gives him a ghost lamp to make whatever he says happen.

videos.title: Predictable Diary. How Horrible
videos.overview: Whatever is written in the magic diary will happen. Suneo grabs it and writes some bad things about Nobita, ending with him being eaten by a lion. The bad things start to happen as predicted.

videos.title: Ace cap
videos.overview: Nobita is hopeless at pitching a ball so Doraemon gives him a hat which makes sure he cannot miss any target, but it turns out that lazy Nobita is not really interested in baseball. He throws a book and it goes back on the shelf where it should be. He is too lazy to walk to Shizuka's house so throws himself to see her, not knowing she is a long way away.

videos.title: Kettle Recorder
videos.overview: The other kids have tape recorders but Nobita's mom won't get him one so Doraemon gives him a tea pot where the words spoken into it come out in balloons. The kids use the speech balloons to get their own back on Gian who has been bullying them.

videos.title: Multiply medicine
videos.overview: Nobita only has one cake left so Doraemon treats it with Peipei medicine to make more but warns Nobita every single cake must be eaten as any remaining cakes double every 5 minutes. Nobita cannot eat them all and suddenly finds himself with lots of cakes on his hands. Even his mom and friends cannot manage them all so as the cakes begin to pile up, and would cover the Earth in just a day, so Doraemon sends them into space.

videos.title: Mad watch
videos.overview: Nobita is due for an hour long moan from his mother, so Doraemon gives him a watch which speeds up or slows down time in any area.

videos.title: Avalanche at Nobita's Study Room
videos.overview: Nobita wants to go skiing with his friends, and his father even gives him some skis but he can't ski. Doraemon produces the equivalent of a Star Trek Holosuite (before the show had them) and it is like skiing in real snow on a real mountain, but it becomes a bit too real, leaving them both in trouble.

videos.title: Sesame Lock
videos.overview: Nobita is in trouble when his mother finds a test paper he failed in, in his drawer. Nobita wants a lock so Doraemon gives him a key which can lock anything. Once done, only the user can open or shut it, using the words: Open Sesame or Close Sesame. The episode ends up with Nobita locked out of the house in heavy rain because he has a cold which has changed his voice so the key no longer recognizes him.

videos.title: Received Coin
videos.overview: Nobita is even lazier than usual so Doraemon gives him a coin which when he sticks to his back means he can become small and attached to the back of others, so use them to get somewhere. This finally backfires when he uses it on Gian who unknowingly sits on tiny Nobita, and farts.

videos.title: Robot pellet
videos.overview: Nobita's mom tells him to clean up his room but he is too lazy so Doraemon gives him a tube of small metal balls which when placed on something inanimate make it behave like a machine and so do what you want. Things start off well, but everything revolts against Nobita and things end up worse than before, just as his mother comes home.

videos.title: Odd Umbrella
videos.overview: It's raining and Nobita is supposed to take an umbrella to his father at the station but he gives one away to Shizuka and Gian grabs the other. However Doraemon has many umbrellas but unfortunately they are all novelty ones like a bat umbrella that flies and carries his father away.

videos.title: Time savings box
videos.overview: Doraemon produces a machine which can save time so it can be used later. It ends with Nobita putting time back 3 hours so he can do the homework he forgot and his father thinking he left work three hours too early so rushing back there.

videos.title: Leading part insertion machine
videos.overview: Suneo has a part in a TV show and the others are jealous. Doraemon produces a ray which allows Nobita to be the main character in a story, TV show or anywhere else, and while Suneo just turns out to be one in a crowd, Nobita gets to be the lead in the show (he has Nobita's face, voice, etc.).

videos.title: Telepath robot
videos.overview: Lazy Nobita is in bed with a minor cold so Doraemon gives him a cap which allows a small robot to read his mind and do what he wants. This leads to the robot stealing Suneo's cake and beating up Gian, unknown by Nobita till he meets them later (both have guessed the robot could have only come from Nobita).

videos.title: Striking the big prize
videos.overview: Nobita's mother complains to his father about wasting money on lottery tickets. Nobita decides to use the time machine to win some money on the lottery. The tickets are printed out with a number and Nobita has no money to buy a ticket but sees his father buy a ticket worth 300,000,000 yen. The family are planning what to do with the money only to find out his father has taken his mother's moan seriously and sold the ticket to someone else.

videos.title: Actual solid body Sunlight photograph camera
videos.overview: After ruining Suneo's old camera, Nobita gives him a camera which takes pictures of people and objects then makes 3D versions of them. Suneo manages to upset his mother, Gian and Shizuka using it and they end up chasing him. One of Gian's friends looks exactly like Nobita, even to the clothes.

videos.title: News Publisher Game
videos.overview: Suneo has got a game which allows him to print his own small newspaper. His first edition comes with a picture of Nobita hitting the ground after Gian has thrown him. Doraemon gives Nobita a machine which will find news and print it but Nobita's run of bad luck goes from bad to worse as more ridiculous pictures of him are taken.

videos.title: Appraising Machine
videos.overview: Shizuka's uncle is an art critic and thinks Nobita's picture is childish so Doraemon gives him a toy that will make anyone think any painting is the best one ever. Nobita loses it and someone else gets all the praise.

videos.title: Skiing in the Park
videos.overview: Nobita is jealous of Suneo who is going far from Tokyo to ski. Doraemon's machine enables any section drawn in chalk to be exchanged for a section of land elsewhere. They end up changing the park (at night) for a snow covered mountain so Nobita can try skiing.

videos.title: The Mouse and The Bomb
videos.overview: Doraemon is even more scared of mice than Nobita's mother is and starts shooting at everything that moves when one turns up in the house.

The Schedule Clock
videos.overview: Doraemon helps Nobita make a schedule, but ends up giving HIMSELF a schedule instead and Nobita takes advantage of this.

Comic Book's Extras from One Hundred Years Later
Huko the Typhoon
videos.overview: Nobita hatches a 22nd century egg and out comes a small typhoon, which he treats as a pet. Then Japan suffers a major typhoon which is heading towards their house which has a loose roof and the little typhoon goes out to try and stop it.
To avoid getting hit by Gian, Nobita uses a shower which makes it look like he is several feet away from his actual position, which allows him to kick Gian without retaliation.

videos.title: Predicting Bug
videos.overview: Nobita who was born on August 7 checks his astrology in a comic and thinks he is due a good week. Doraemon gives him a small mechanical bug which if you predict something, it can come true. The problem is that Nobita is a pessimist who thinks the worst, and it was last week's comic he was using.

videos.title: Only instead of the usual bar
Playing in the sky is dangerous
Surpised All Encyclopedia: Doraemon and Dora
Future Checkbook
videos.overview: It starts with Nobita asking his mother for money. She refuses and says to Doraemon that she will give it to him the next day, but he wants it today because of the new comic book series he hasn't bought. And his friends did and will laugh at him if he hasn't bought the comic. Doraemon gives him a checkbook out of his 4D pocket and tells him to write the amount of money on the check and sign it. Nobita writes the amount of money for the comic book, but accidentally writes 1500 yen. Nobita fears that the cashier will not accept, but he successfully buys the book and the cashier gives him 1350 yen. Nobita buys a box of toy airplanes, three cars, a big house and gives Suneo and Gian 1000 yen each with the checkbook. Nobita's mother and uncle give him money but the envelope is empty. He asks Doraemon about this, but he tells him that the checkbook's money is from a future deposit to take out and it was all used up so the envelope is empty. Doraemon takes out a calculator and finds out there will be no more money for Nobita until he is 43 years old and it is summer. Doraemon tells him to ask the cashier for check refunds and he leaves while Doraemon sleeps.

videos.title: Mini Pet - A Lion
videos.overview: It starts with Nobita and Gian playing and Suneo brings the Dog King and says if anyone disobeys him, he will punish the one who disobeys. This makes Nobita angry, and he and Doraemon catch a lion. The lion later develops a friendship with Nobita but they send the lion back to its place. Before it, he meets the Dog King in the night. It ends with the next evening after sending the lion back, Suneo tells Nobita to kneel down at the Dog King, which he refuses. Suneo tells the Dog King to punish Nobita, but he runs away instead. (This episode has since been remade.)

videos.title: Materials Quality Changing Machine
videos.overview: It starts with a baseball thrown into a window. The owner scolded Nobita even though Gian does it but he forces Nobita to admit. He scolded to Doraemon why don't the owner change the glass to metal? Doraemon give Nobita the Materials Quality Changing Machine and he change many things to another material. Gian took it but requested Doraemon to repair it after accidentally turning his house to paper house.

videos.title: Plant Pen
videos.overview: Shizuka likes flowers but Nobita has none. However a magic pen allows flowers or trees drawn on paper to come alive. When Doraemon tries it to make a tree house, he unknowingly uses a bit of paper with an advert for a washing machine on the other side with drastic results.

videos.title: Special Bonsai
videos.overview: Doraemon and Nobita fought over one cake, and Doraemon decided to increase the amount so that both can have a share. Doraemon plants the cake like a seed into the soil of "Special Bonsai" and waters it twice. The plant grows fast in the process of flowers dropping and bearing 14 fruits. The fruits all contained a similar cake each, and both boys are unable to finish them all. Doraemon felt thirsty and Nobita suggested repeating the procedure with a bottle of orange juice, which they succeeded. They are also unable to finish all the orange juice, and Nobita suggested getting Shizuka to come over for the cake and drinks, as well as bringing along her favourite doll. Together, Nobita and Shizuka increased the number of dolls and toy cars using the bonsai, and played with them on the road. Suneo and Gian were shocked at the number of similar toys they had, and upon Nobita's explanation, Gian robbed the bonsai and coerced Nobita into telling him the instructions, but Nobita told him only to plant the item he intend to increase as a seed (without watering it). Gian did so with a 1000 Japanese yen note, and the plant bears smaller and fewer fruits due to lack of water. Gian cried upon opening all the fruits only to find that the notes are so tiny that renders it unusable.

videos.title: Famous Painting Checker
videos.overview: While Nobita and his friends are at Suneo's house admiring Pablo Picasso's paintings Suneo's father bought, Nobita observed the most expensive one and finds it similar to one he drawn in the past, to which Suneo rebuked. After finding the drawing, Doraemon assumed he copied the work of Picasso's, but Nobita insisted that it is coincidental that both are similar. Doraemon decided to check for the sendimental value using the "Famous Painting Checker". After screening the drawing, the machine explained that it is worthless in the future, but very valuable in year 1944's Europe. As there is no such painting then, Nobita decided to take the drawing to that era despite the ongoing World War II then. Once they reached 1944's Europe, they saved a girl, who turns out to be Picasso's granddaughter, and reveals that Picasso was forced to draw a painting by a Nazi soldier in his mansion. Doraemon eats “Hitler's Pills" which gives him the authority to order the Nazi soldiers to leave. Nobita's drawing was discovered by the girl who claims that it is drawn by her younger brother, Tonio, who was killed in a blast sometime ago, and Picasso stopped drawing since then over the loss of his grandson. Upon seeing the drawing, Picasso picked up the paintbrush and made some adjustments to the drawing, the end result of which resembles what Nobita saw of Picasso's painting in Suneo's house. He explained that Tonio drew a similar work at the age of three, and Nobita's drawing helped him to revive the passion of drawing. The episodes end with Nobita drawing Shizuka in Picasso's style, thinking in his mind that it is him who originally produced Picasso's main drawing.

videos.title: I Hate Doraemon!?
videos.overview: After seeing Nobita and Doraemon have a huge fight, Sewashi sends Dorami to help Nobita, leaving Doraemon feeling left out. This episode was remade in 2005 as Goodbye, Nobita! Doraemon Goes Back to the Future.

videos.title: Is Nobita Getting Married?!
videos.overview: After misinterpreting a scene where Shizuka and Dekisugi are acting out Snow White’s proposal, Nobita and Doraemon travel to the future to witness Nobita’s wedding.

videos.title: Magical Girl Shizu-chan
videos.overview: Shizuka wishes to be a magical girl for one day, so Doraemon gives her some gadgets which enable to become one. However, she ends up coming home late and gets locked out of the house. Remade as "Magical Witch Shizuka-chan" in 2005 in the same series, and again in the 2005 remake.

videos.title: Gulliver’s Adventure on the Backyard Hill
videos.overview: Nobita’s plane crashes in the jungle while he is flying. Doraemon, Gian, Suneo, and Shizuka set out to find him. After facing many challenges, they finally manage to rescue Nobita.

videos.title: Changing Newspaper Post
videos.overview: Nobita wishes to the read news every morning. Doraemon gives him a gadget where he could print the newspaper by changing the date. Nobita misuses the gadget but at the end saves the neighbour's house from robbery.

videos.title: The God Robot
videos.overview: Doraemon gives Nobita a God Robot that can grant any three wishes. Together, Doraemon and Nobita meet Shizuka and help her fulfill her wish with the gadget. This episode was later remade as God Robot Extends His Hand of Love! in the 2005 series.

videos.title: Nobita's Space Shuttle
videos.overview: Doraemon gives Nobita a rocket straw that he could use to fly. Nobita and his friends create a spaceship with the help of these straws. But Later, Gian and Suneo hijack the spaceship and crash it.

videos.title: Dad’s Salary Trouble
videos.overview: On payday, Nobita’s mom makes a special meal for Dad, but he comes home late after his boss invites him out. The next day, they find out his salary is missing! To help, Nobita and Doraemon use the time machine to search for the lost money.

videos.title: Cross Switch
videos.overview: As Nobita doesn't wish to go to school, Doraemon gives him a cross switch gadget, with which one could exchange their life with others. Nobita misuses the gadget by exchanging himself with his friends. Remade as This Road, That Road, and the Easy Road in the 2005 series.

videos.title: Ventriloquist Robot
videos.overview: After Nobita fails in his test, he takes help from Doraemon and uses a ventriloquist doll, to become a better speaker and convince his mother. He later uses the doll to convince Gian to stop singing his new song.

videos.title: Nobita's Fairy Tale Trip
videos.overview: Nobita uses Doraemon's fairy tale entry shoes to travel from one fairy tale story to another and later invites Shizuka over to enter the story of Cinderella. However, Shizuka ends up losing her shoe and gets left behind in the story, leaving Nobita to rescue her before she marries the prince.

videos.title: The Faithful Dog Robot
videos.overview: Nobita wishes for a pet that will be his loyal bodyguard, so Doraemon gives him a robot dog named Chukenper, capable of fulfilling any desire Nobita has. But things quickly spiral out of control when Chukenper starts granting every wish—intentional or not!

videos.title: The World Peace Badge
videos.overview: Nobita wants to join an organization after his friends become members. But he soon realizes it’s a scam when the goons threaten him and steal all his money. Doraemon then steps in to help Nobita make things right.

videos.title: The Honesty Waves
videos.overview: When Motoyama refuses to return Suneo’s binoculars, Doraemon uses the Honesty Waves to make him confess. But soon the truth-spilling waves spread across town, causing chaos.

videos.title: The Obedience Cap
videos.overview: Nobita gets Doraemon’s Obedience Cap and finds a real lion in an abandoned park. He tries to train the lion to impress his friends, but things go wrong, and suddenly the lion is bossing Nobita around—even trying to eat him! Doraemon rushes to save him, and the lion is safely taken to the zoo.

videos.title: The Caring Robot
videos.overview: Nobita feels sad from being scolded, so Doraemon gives him a kind robot. But when it always lets him off, trouble follows. Doraemon shows that this future would make him a beggar, so Nobita asks for a strict robot that won’t let him eat until he finishes his homework.

videos.title: The Caring Rope
videos.overview: Nobita’s parents leave for a wedding, and Doraemon has to go out for work. He gives Nobita the Caring Rope to take care of him. The rope takes care of the house, helps him win a baseball game, and even lets him have fun with Shizuka, Gian, and Suneo. When Doraemon returns, everything is already taken care of, and Nobita had a great time!

videos.title: Robot Snowman
videos.overview: Nobita makes a robot snowman during the winter. The snowman follows him back home and causes some chaos.

videos.title: Fantasy Animal Safari Park
videos.overview: Nobita and his friends visit a safari park filled with imaginary creatures like unicorns. But when their Safari Craft crashes, they find themselves stranded—and this time, Doraemon isn’t there to help!

videos.title: The Air Relay Satellite
videos.overview: When Suneo shows off his collection of world air cans, Nobita and Doraemon use the Air Relay Satellite to experience the different airs from around the globe.

videos.title: The Water Video
videos.overview: Remade as The Water I Had Seen in the 2005 series.

videos.title: Time Bomb Sticker
videos.overview: When Nobisuke comes down with the hiccups, Nobita and Doraemon use a Time Bomb Sticker to frighten him and make his hiccups go away. They later use the sticker to scare Gian, but things go haywire when Suneo takes the sticker and gives it to Shizuka.

videos.title: Identical Scarecrow
videos.overview: Nobita uses Doraemon’s Identical Scarecrow to protect horsetails, but after Suneo destroys it, he makes scarecrows of Gian and Shizuka. Meanwhile, Tamako uses the gadget to make a scarecrow of herself and force Nobita to do his homework.

videos.title: Snow in March
videos.overview: Snow does not rain down on Christmas Eve, but the forecast says otherwise and Shizuka is disappointed. Nobita begs Doraemon for a Weather Box, but it is broken. It starts snowing excessively. Remade as Snow at Christmas in the 2005 series.

videos.title: The Air Crayon
videos.overview: Doraemon introduces a crayon used to make drawings and other markings on areas of thin air.

videos.title: The Winning Postcard
videos.overview: Nobita really wants to win a lucky draw so he uses Doraemon's savings to buy 5 postcards. However the postcards mysteriously vanish leading Nobita to use a postcard that he found in his room.

videos.title: Let's Play With Water
videos.overview: On a hot summer day, Nobita and his friends head to the beach and use Doraemon’s Water Processing Sprinkles to create fun water objects. Remade in 2005 as 'Water Processing Sprinkle.'

videos.title: The Mystery of Suneo’s Test Score
videos.overview: Suneo refuses to show his full marks to Gian and Nobita, making them suspicious. With Doraemon’s help, they try to uncover the truth before Suneo’s mother finds out.

videos.title: A Sweethome with Shizuka
videos.overview: After getting jealous once again of Shizuka and Dekisugi showing affection for each other, Nobita uses Doraemon's Sweethome to make Shizuka fall in love with him.

videos.title: The Tipsy Cap
videos.overview: After seeing his father and friends drinking beer, Nobita uses Doraemon’s gadget, the Drunken Lid, to get tipsy too!

videos.title: Locker Cutter
videos.overview: Nobita uses Doraemon’s Locker Cutter gadget to play tricks on Gian, Suneo, and Shizuka, but they team up with Doraemon to teach him a lesson!

videos.title: Underground Fishing
videos.overview: After Suneo brags about his fishing experience, Doraemon and Nobita use a gadget to do underground fishing in the empty lot.

videos.title: Echo Mountain
videos.overview: Tamako tells Nobita to complete his homework before he goes out to play. Doraemon helps Nobita with his new echo mountain gadget, but Nobita misuses it on his mother when she falls asleep and steps out to play. Nobita uses the gadget against Gian, as he never sticks to his words. After Nobita and Doraemon return home, Tamako yells at Nobita and makes him complete his homework.

videos.title: Liquid and Vapour Pills
videos.overview: To beat the summer heat, Doraemon gives Nobita pills that turn him into liquid or gas. Nobita uses them to prank his mom and Gian—but when the effects wear off, Gian gets his revenge!

videos.title: I've Got a Spare Fourth Dimensional Pocket
videos.overview: Doraemon takes his 4D Pocket to dry, and assures Nobita that he has a spare 4D Pocket which he can use. When Doraemon goes out on a date with a cat, Nobita takes the original 4D Pocket.

videos.title: Magic Handkerchief
videos.overview: Doraemon gives Nobita a magic handkerchief so that he can impress Shizuka. Later, Nobita disappears under the magical handkerchief but his friends find him.

videos.title: Instant Sea Making Machine
videos.overview: Nobita learns to swim with Doraemon’s Instant Sea Machine, but when Gian and Suneo steal the goggles and the machine breaks, the water vanishes—sending them tumbling into a fountain.

videos.title: The Room Guard Set
videos.overview: To keep Nobita from getting scolded by his mother, Doraemon uses a Room Guard Set that prevents her from entering his room without the correct password. However, when Nobita changes the password to a harder one, he forgets it—leading to a shocking outcome! This episode was later remade as Entry to Nobita's Room is Forbidden in the 2005 series.

videos.title: The Mask of Academic Appears
videos.overview: Nobita is slacking off on his schoolwork when a mysterious masked man appears and offers to be his personal tutor. The Mask of Academic even uses a whip to make sure Nobita studies!

videos.title: The Spirit Robot
videos.overview: Suneo says he has a ghost protecting him, which scares Nobita. Doraemon gives Nobita a Spirit Robot, an invisible ghost-like gadget, but it’s too protective, frightening his parents, friends, and even Nobita himself. Since it only lasts 24 hours, Nobita keeps his distance, even eating dinner on the roof to stay out of trouble

videos.title: Gian’s Troublesome Concert
videos.overview: Gian makes Nobita and Doraemon organize his concert. No one wants to come because he sings badly, so Doraemon uses special tickets and a magic microphone. In the end, the concert is a big success!

videos.title: Nobita and the Feelings Monitor
videos.overview: Doraemon gives Nobita the Feelings Monitor, a gadget with antennas and a cap that lets him feel what others feel. Nobita uses it to copy Dekisugi’s homework and watch Gian scold Suneo. The last antenna is on a boy named Naoki, and when he falls into a river, Nobita feels it in time and saves him. Doraemon is proud of Nobita for helping.

videos.title: 合成鉱山の素
videos.overview: Elements of Synthetic Mine

videos.title: Nobita’s Son Ran Away From Home
videos.overview: Tired of Nobita’s constant laziness, his father scolds him for not studying. Feeling upset, Nobita plans to run away—until Nobisuke, his son from the future, suddenly shows up. Wanting to escape his own duties, Nobisuke decides to stay in the past, leading to unexpected chaos.

videos.title: Let's Return Sake With The Liquid Spawner
The Harley's Tail
videos.overview: Nobita and Doraemon travel back to the past to find out about the family's buried treasure.

videos.title: The Adventure Tea
videos.overview: On a day that Nobita's mom asks his dad to fix the roof of the house, he is sent on a thrilling adventure after he consumes the Adventure Tea.

videos.title: The Prank Toy Machine
videos.overview: When Suneo invites Nobita over only to prank him, Nobita uses Doraemon's Prank Toy Machine to play pranks on Suneo in revenge.

videos.title: Anything Plush Toy Set
videos.overview: When Suneo unintentionally upsets Shizuka by buying a plush toy she wanted to buy, Nobita and Doraemon use the Anything Plush Toy set to create more plush toys and cheer her up. Remade in the 2005 series as "Everything is Doll."

videos.title: The Friend Circle
videos.overview: Nobita wishes to befriend a girl named Mizue, but her grandfather Kaminari dislikes him. Doraemon gives him a gadget called a Friend Circle so Nobita can get closer to the girl by making friends with Kaminari.

videos.title: The Confidence Eliminator
videos.overview: Doraemon uses The Confidence Eliminator to complain to the Snack House boss about the dorayaki, but Nobita uses it to upset Suneo, Gian and Shizuka.

videos.title: The Opposite World Mirror
videos.overview: Tired of being bullied by Gian and Suneo, Nobita asks Doraemon to show him an alternate world where he’s the neighborhood bully. But when Bully Nobita escapes into the real world, chaos ensues!

videos.title: Date-Changing Chalk
videos.overview: Doraemon and Nobita use the Date-Changing Chalk to travel to the past. Nobita even visits the future and meets his future self! When Tamako erases the chalk, Nobita uses the time machine to return home safely.

videos.title: Ultra Mixer / Sneeze Busters!
videos.overview: Doraemon's latest gadget combines two objects into one. Although it seems like a convenient gadget to have, Nobita and Doraemon can't seem to find the right use for it.

videos.title: Demons In! Luck In! Bean / Good-Bye Shizuka Part II
videos.overview: On the day of the bean-throwing ceremony, Suneo asks Nobita for help to throw Gian out of his house. Doraemon offers the "Demons Out! Luck in! Bean," which sends things from the inside to the outside.

videos.title: Gian's Stew / Animal Training Shop Opens!
videos.overview: Upset with Gian's badly cooked home meal, Doraemon takes out the "Super Gourmet Spice," which makes any food delicious.

videos.title: A Warm Snow Fight / Suneo Works At the Goda Family
videos.overview: Doraemon lures Nobita out with a gadget that can create snow. The two of them try to see what kinds of snow they can make.

videos.title: We Started a TV Station / Freeze
videos.overview: When Nobita sees Suneo on TV, he asks Doraemon to put him on too. With the help of Doraemon's gadget, the rest of the gang compete to see who can make the best TV show.

videos.title: Devotion Horsetail / Delay Candy
videos.overview: Nobita gets a gadget that can make a person become totally devoted to someone. He wants to use it on Shizuka so that she can take care of him. But will it all go according to his plan?

videos.title: Let’s Enjoy Life / Nobita’s Son Has Run Away From Home
videos.overview: Nobita is bored and asks Doraemon to tell him a funny story. Instead, Doraemon shows him that there’s definitely a time and place for laughter.

videos.title: Delicious Hot Spring Bathing / Treasure Hunting Kit
videos.overview: Nobita's mother tells him no snacking before shower,so Nobita asks Doraemon for a gadget that changes water into whatever he likes.

videos.title: Doraemon's 100 Year Time Capsule
videos.overview: Nobita takes Doraemon's capsule as the container to bury it as his time-capsule. Turns out it's a time traveling capsule that can go 100 years forwards or backwards.

videos.title: A Golden Week Sheltered from People / The Apartment Tree
videos.overview: Nobita is looking forward to going to Mt. Hakoge with his family for Golden Week. But Nobita's Dad suddenly cancels the trip when he overhears Gian talking about how crowded it is.

videos.title: Fake Aliens / Doron Leaf
videos.overview: Gian and Suneo use trick photography to fool Nobita into thinking a UFO and alien appeared in the empty lot. Nobita is completely fooled and asks Doraemon to go to the empty lot at night to wait for the UFO and alien.

videos.title: Let's Watch the Solar Eclipse / Jaiko, the Comic Artist
videos.overview: Everyone is excited to watch the annual solar eclipse. But unfortunately, when the day comes, the sky is covered with clouds. Using one of Doraemon's gadgets, Doraemon and Nobita go above the clouds to watch the eclipse.

videos.title: This Road, That Road, and the Easy Road / Shizuka in My Pocket
videos.overview: Nobita is tired of the same old routine, day after day. Doraemon gives him a gadget called Cross Switch that allows him to become someone else, hoping that this is an easy way to be happier in life.

videos.title: A Visit to Jaiko's Comic / The Weather Box
videos.overview: Gian is worried that his sister Jaiko's comics are not good enough for the competition she is entering. So the gang decides to make some changes to the plot so that Jaiko will have a chance to win the contest.

videos.title: I'll Eat Candy and Become a Singer 2 / Go Back Light
videos.overview: Nobita and friends are invited to a recital given by Gian. To make the experience soothing, Doraemon produces the Voiceprint Candy Making Machine. The machine takes a person's voice and makes it into candy.

videos.title: The Chance Maker / Happy Promenade
videos.overview: Nobita and his family get caught up in playing double or nothing game. But will greed get the best of them?

videos.title: The Look Alike Bean Jelly / Forgotten Item Delivery Machine
videos.overview: Nobita wants to look like an actor Shizuka has a crush on so that she will like him. But he soon finds out looks are not everything.

videos.title: Bug-bug Hero On the Scene! / One-Inch Boy
videos.overview: Nobita wishes he could be a superhero, so Doraemon gives him a belt that gives him the abilities of various bugs. He goes out to patrol the town, but his efforts are less than successful.

videos.title: Nobita's Room is Off Limits / Have no fear! Gian's Insurance Plan
videos.overview: Nobita hates the fact that his mom always goes through his room. Doraemon gives him a security system to keep her out.

videos.title: Showdown! Gian vs. The Monster Army / World Record Rock
videos.overview: Nobita and his friends have created a secret hideout in the woods. Unfortunately, Gian decides to claim it for himself. Doraemon gives Nobita and his friends a lei that will transform them into monsters so that they can scare Gian out.

videos.title: Charge! Submarine Nobita / Job Hunting is Fun
videos.overview: Knowing Nobita has a cold, Suneo invites him to go to his island summer house with his friends. With Doraemon's help, Nobita is able to go to the island and teach Suneo a lesson.

videos.title: Can't Quit the Life of a Ghost / How to Get a Response
videos.overview: Nobita is mad at Gian but he doesn't have the guts to confront him now. He tells Doraemon once he's dead he's going to come back to haunt him. Doraemon gives him a gadget that will turn Nobita into a ghost.

videos.title: Go, Flowing Noodles! / Ten Minute Delay Psychic Powers
videos.overview: Nobita's father brings home a 'nagashi somen' (flowing noodles) machine he got from the office. Nobita loves it so much he wants to share it with Shizuka.

videos.title: Big Adventure Game Book / Incident Bomb
videos.overview: Doraemon introduces Nobita to a game that takes him literally into a book of adventures. Shizuka is in the last page, waiting to be rescued. Nobita goes into the book with Dekisugi. They must answer riddles to get to Shizuka.

videos.title: Flying Fish / Play Favorite Tree Badge
videos.overview: Suneo brags about his pet fish (carp). When Nobita wants his own fish, Doraemon comes up with a way for Nobita to get fish and to have fun with them at the same time.

videos.title: Werewolf Cream 2 / Human Time Switch
videos.overview: Doraemon and Nobita are trying to decide if a werewolf is scarier than Mom when she is angry. They agree to find out for themselves by using Werewolf Cream.

videos.title: Nobita Wins with a Cucumber? / Extension Spray
videos.overview: With a little push from Doraemon, Nobita learns that sometimes he doesn't need to rely on gadgets, but he can come through all on his own.

videos.title: Sensational Duo: Jai & Sune / Horror of Happy Playing Cards
videos.overview: Suneo has a dream that he wins a singing contest with Gian. When a real-life opportunity comes up, Gian forces Suneo to enter the contest.

videos.title: Great Performance Clapperboard / Sloth Suit
videos.overview: Nobita’s school is putting on a play and is berated by his classmates for his poor acting skills. But, with the help of Doraemon’s gadget, Nobita proves to everyone that he is a great actor.

videos.title: Discipline Candy / The Horn of Hamelin
videos.overview: Suneo's great-grandma comes to visit who is full of sayings and old wives' tales, which he laughs at. However, Doraemon decides to teach him a lesson.

videos.title: River Swimming with Sake / Auto Revenge Radar
videos.overview: Nobita's dad is working late every night, and he is drinking sparingly from his very expensive bottle of spirits to make them last. But, Nobita and Doraemon have a plan to multiply the bottles so that he can have as much as he likes.

videos.title: Let's All Dance Shoes / The Tanuki that Fell in Love
videos.overview: When Nobita finds out girls like guys who can dance, he immediately wants to be a good dancer. With Doraemon's gadget, he's on his way to being the best dancer, but Nobita soon finds out that being a good dancer may have its pitfalls too.

videos.title: The Dreadful Gian Pizza / Let's Form a Band! No-Beatles!
videos.overview: Gian is so moved at his first taste of pizza that he asks Doraemon to help him open a pizza shop. Everything was set up for the shop to run smoothly, but Gian decides to change the recipes to his liking.

videos.title: Human Piggy Bank / Super Detective Nobita is Born!
videos.overview: Nobita has a habit of spending all his money and not saving any of it. Doraemon tries to teach him the importance of saving, but his lesson turns out to be more costly for Nobita.

videos.title: I Want to Eat Crab! / Shopping in a Different Era
videos.overview: Suneo boasts about eating king crab all the time. Nobita lies and says he's eaten it before and that there are many in his kitchen right now. Gian invites himself over for dinner, and now, Nobita must find a way to get the expensive king crab.

videos.title: Ultra Good Fortune Sushi Roll / The Snow is Burning Hot
videos.overview: Nobita makes Shizuka angry, and he wants to make it up with her but is clueless about this. Doraemon tells him that his wish will come true if he eats a special sushi roll

videos.title: Love at First Sight / Shizuka’s Space Outdoor
videos.overview: Suneo falls in love with Suzie, his English neighbor. He wants her to love him back and asks Nobita, Doraemon, and Gian for their help in exchange for food.

videos.title: Phantom Thief / Take to the Sky in Bird Caps
videos.overview: Suneo tricks Nobita into trading away a rare dinosaur trading card. Doraemon offers Nobita a set of gadgets that allow Nobita to fool Suneo into giving up the card.

videos.title: Mom and Dad Battle It Out / The Always-Accurate Palmistry
videos.overview: Nobita and Dad are at loggerheads with Doraemon and Mom over their pet peeves. The only way to settle it is by an all-out battle at the Nobi home.

videos.title: Explosive Pepper / Flower Viewing or Bust
videos.overview: Doraemon saves Nobita's from getting late to school by blowing him to class with a sneeze powered by 'Explosive Pepper.' Gian takes it away, however, and uses the Explosive Pepper to cause trouble around the neighborhood.

videos.title: Budgeting for a Trip to Hawaii / Shizuka's Magic Cloak
videos.overview: Nobita has his sights set on going to Hawaii, but there is no money in the family budget. With the help of Doraemon's Home Budget Chestnut, the entire family goes on an extreme austere budget for a month.

videos.title: Napping in Heaven / Dictator Switch
videos.overview: Nobita is having a hard time relaxing with all the noise, so he asks Doraemon for a gadget that allows him to get onto a cloud. Nobita invites Shizuka over, and the two of them create a paradise, but Gian and Suneo have some plans of their own.

videos.title: Instant Mom / Gian is Being Targeted
videos.overview: Nobita's mom is overworked, and Nobita wants to do something to help her out. Doraemon gives him a gadget that can create clones of his mom. Nobita's mom is pleased by how much time she's saving but, feels less fulfilled.

videos.title: Escape! The Honekawa House of Terror / Helmet of Telepathy
videos.overview: Nobita wants to hang out with his friends, but they all have other plans. He convinces them to join him for a quick game he finds that belongs to Doraemon. But, the game traps everyone within the house.

videos.title: House Kopter / Shizuka's Terrible Birthday
videos.overview: Nobita is jealous of Suneo's camper, so Doraemon gives him a gadget that can make his whole house fly. Nobita invites Shizuka on a trip to the Nashi Highlands, but, they have to rush back home before Nobita's mom finds out what's going on.

videos.title: Vermilion Mixing Stick / Gian Becomes a Panda
videos.overview: Doraemon gives Nobita a stick that allows him to take on the traits of those around him, to improve his baseball. Unfortunately, Nobita strikes out at the game, and this infuriates Gian.

videos.title: Gifting Cloth / Invincible! Black Belt Nobita
videos.overview: Nobita's mom needs a gift on short notice, so Doraemon helps her out with a cloth that produces gifts for other people. Nobita cooks up a plan to use the cloth to get a videogame console but, the cloth is stolen by Suneo and Gian.

videos.title: Gian’s Farewell Concert / Dream Director’s Chair
videos.overview: Everyone is ecstatic when Gian announces he’ll quit singing. Gian plans one big farewell concert to signal the end. But are Gian’s intentions pure? Or is there an ulterior motive for his announcement?

videos.title: All the Way From the Country of the Future
videos.overview: While Nobita relaxes in his room, he hears a voice. Just then, Doraemon pops out from the drawer and tells him about his future. Sewashi enters and introduces Doraemon as a robot from the 22nd century who has come to help Nobita. Doraemon shows Nobita his gadgets and promises to help him whenever required.
